# Sign Language Translator

> A browser-based demo that turns webcam hand landmarks into live captions and lets people train a personal gesture vocabulary.

## Main page

- [Live translator](https://sashwathsubra.github.io/sign-language-translator-with-custom-hand-sign-recognition/): Start the camera, view captions, and record custom gesture templates.
- [Project source](https://github.com/sashwathsubra/sign-language-translator-with-custom-hand-sign-recognition): Open-source implementation and deployment notes.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://sashwathsubra.github.io/sign-language-translator-with-custom-hand-sign-recognition/privacy-policy.html): What data is collected and how it is handled. No first-party data collection; no analytics.
- [Terms of Service](https://sashwathsubra.github.io/sign-language-translator-with-custom-hand-sign-recognition/terms.html): Acceptable use, no-warranty disclaimer, and limitation of liability.
- [Cookie Policy](https://sashwathsubra.github.io/sign-language-translator-with-custom-hand-sign-recognition/cookie-policy.html): No first-party cookies are set. localStorage is used for gesture templates only.

## Technical notes

- The frontend uses MediaPipe Tasks Vision in the browser.
- Gesture templates are stored locally in the browser for the demo.
- The companion backend exposes a WebSocket demo service for server-side processing.
